verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for a managed database service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ObsessionDB documenting one: the docs cover ClickHouse compatibility, the MCP server, CHKit and monitoring. The llms.txt and docs.md probes show machine-readable docs exist, but neither is an interactive, runnable API reference, so neither earns credit for this story.
